title: A positive-variance normal law has its location-scale density
statement: Assume AC. For m in R and sigma>0, N(m,sigma^2), defined as the affine pushforward of N(0,1), has Lebesgue density g(m,sigma;y)=(2 pi sigma^2)^(-1/2) exp(-(y-m)^2/(2 sigma^2)).
axiom_use: AC is used for the library standard-normal law and implies Countable Choice, which is the hypothesis of the cited C^1 change-of-variables theorem. No further choice is used.

references.title: Andrew Gelman, John B. Carlin, Hal S. Stern, David B. Dunson, Aki Vehtari, and Donald B. Rubin, Bayesian Data Analysis, 3rd ed., §5.4
Alicia A. Johnson, Miles Q. Ott, and Mine Dogucu, Bayes Rules!, Chapter 16, §16.3
